name: Krusch Context MCP
description: Local-first working memory, span-grounded invariant steering, and decision lineage for coding agents (SQLite by default, optional PostgreSQL). Context retrieval and health checks follow your normal Guard policy (may refresh provenance/drift metadata); memory writes, revisions, and feedback updates require review. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Use krusch_context_retrieve and krusch_context_health to read active invariants, episodic memories, and project state briefings; they do not add or revise memories, but health and state retrieval may update memory provenance/drift flags in the local store.
Keep krusch_context_remember, krusch_context_revise, and krusch_context_nudge on Review: remember and revise mutate project memories or nuggets, and nudge (action='feedback') updates rule weights.
Leave STORAGE_MODE on its default sqlite setting (.agent/context.db) unless you explicitly want shared PostgreSQL storage across machines.
